question: Tempo's metrics generator module uses Prometheus storage.Appendable and storage.Appender interfaces extensively for collecting and writing generated metrics. The registry in modules/generator/registry/registry.go holds a storage.Appendable field, and the metric interface (counter, histogram, gauge, native_histogram) requires collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) error. The storage wrapper in modules/generator/storage/instance.go extends storage.Appendable. Test files define mock appenders (noopAppender, capturingAppender) that implement the full Appender interface including Append(), AppendExemplar(), AppendHistogram(), Commit(), Rollback(), UpdateMetadata(), AppendCTZeroSample(), and AppendHistogramCTZeroSample(). Given that Prometheus has introduced a new AppenderV2 interface in storage/interface_append.go that consolidates all these methods into a single Append(ref, ls, st, t, v, h, fh, opts) call, which specific files in Tempo and in Thanos (pkg/receive/writer.go ReceiveAppender, pkg/receive/multitsdb.go, pkg/receive/handler.go, pkg/receive/handler_otlp.go) would need to migrate their Appender implementations and consumers to AppenderV2?

answer.summary: The AppenderV2 interface in Prometheus (storage/interface_append.go) consolidates the V1 Appender methods (Append, AppendExemplar, AppendHistogram, UpdateMetadata, AppendCTZeroSample, AppendHistogramCTZeroSample, Commit, Rollback) into a single unified Append(ref SeriesRef, ls labels.Labels, st, t int64, v float64, h *histogram.Histogram, fh *histogram.FloatHistogram, opts AppendV2Options) call plus AppenderTransaction (Commit/Rollback). The AppendV2Options struct carries metadata, exemplars, and rejection flags. Prometheus also provides a LimitedAppenderV1 bridge and AppenderV2AsLimitedV1() adapter for migration. The following files in Tempo and Thanos would need to migrate.

interfaces: AppendableV2 — returns AppenderV2 via AppenderV2(ctx context.Context)

AppenderV2 — embeds AppenderTransaction, single Append(ref SeriesRef, ls labels.Labels, st, t int64, v float64, h *histogram.Histogram, fh *histogram.FloatHistogram, opts AppendV2Options) (SeriesRef, error)
LimitedAppenderV1 — transitional bridge, embeds AppenderTransaction plus Append and AppendHistogram from V1 signatures
prometheus_appenderv2_definition.migration_helpers: AppenderV2AsLimitedV1() wraps AppenderV2 as LimitedAppenderV1 for gradual migration

tempo_files_requiring_migration.reason: Holds a storage.Appendable field and defines the metric interface with collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64). The Appendable field must change to AppendableV2, and the metric interface signature must change from storage.Appender to AppenderV2. The collectMetrics method on ManagedRegistry calls appender methods (Append, AppendHistogram, AppendExemplar, Commit) that must migrate to the single AppenderV2.Append call.
tempo_files_requiring_migration.changes_needed: Change appendable field type from storage.Appendable to storage.AppendableV2, change metric interface collectMetrics parameter from storage.Appender to storage.AppenderV2

tempo_files_requiring_migration.reason: Implements collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) for the counter metric type. Calls appender.Append() with V1 signature (ref, labels, t, v). Must migrate to AppenderV2.Append(ref, ls, 0, t, v, nil, nil, opts).
tempo_files_requiring_migration.changes_needed: Update collectMetrics signature to accept AppenderV2, replace appender.Append(ref, labels, t, v) with AppenderV2.Append(ref, labels, 0, t, v, nil, nil, AppendV2Options{})

tempo_files_requiring_migration.changes_needed: Update collectMetrics to AppenderV2, replace separate Append/AppendExemplar calls with unified AppenderV2.Append calls with exemplars in opts

tempo_files_requiring_migration.changes_needed: Update collectMetrics signature and Append calls to AppenderV2

Calls appender.Append() for float samples and appender.AppendHistogram() for native histograms, plus AppendExemplar for exemplars. Must migrate to single AppenderV2.Append with h/fh parameters and exemplars in opts.
tempo_files_requiring_migration.changes_needed: Update collectMetrics to AppenderV2, replace Append/AppendHistogram/AppendExemplar with unified AppenderV2.Append

Must migrate to implement AppenderV2 with single Append method and AppendV2Options.

thanos_files_requiring_migration.reason: Defines ReceiveAppender struct that embeds storage.Appender and overrides Append(ref, lset, t, v) for future timestamp validation. The Writer.Write method calls app.Append(), app.AppendHistogram(), app.AppendExemplar(), and app.Commit() — all V1 Appender methods. The Appendable interface returns (storage.Appender, error). Must migrate ReceiveAppender to embed/implement AppenderV2, consolidate the validation into the single AppenderV2.Append call, and update the Write method's usage pattern.

The MultiTSDB.Appender method and tenant struct produce V1 Appenders from the underlying TSDB. Must change to produce AppenderV2 from the TSDB's AppenderV2 method.

While handler.go doesn't directly call Appender methods, it depends on the Writer and Appendable types. The handleRequest/remoteWrite flow passes through Writer which uses V1 Appender. Handler needs to be compatible with the updated Writer interface.

The converted time series are passed through the same Appendable->Appender pipeline. Must be compatible with AppenderV2 migration.

answer.migration_pattern: Prometheus provides AppenderV2AsLimitedV1() as a bridge adapter, allowing downstream projects to migrate incrementally. The V1 Appender methods (Append, AppendExemplar, AppendHistogram, UpdateMetadata, AppendCTZeroSample, AppendHistogramCTZeroSample) are consolidated into a single AppenderV2.Append(ref, ls, st, t, v, h, fh, opts) call where exemplars go into opts.Exemplars, metadata goes into opts.Metadata, and start timestamps become the st parameter. Commit/Rollback remain via the embedded AppenderTransaction interface.
